title: Skill front matter
description: The front matter of SKILL.md in skills/<code>/, as the Agent Skills convention has it. Other fields of the convention, and fields of a tool's own, are allowed and delivered as they are.

name.description: The skill's name. It equals the name of its directory, which is the resource's code.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. The AI reads it to decide when to load the skill.
